sourceNotes.rawContent:
A little jar of beautiful surprises! 💛 Our Classic Mystery Jewellery Jar is thoughtfully filled with 3–4 surprise jewellery pieces featuring a mix of trendy anti-tarnish and Korean-style jewellery.
Every jar is a fun mystery — you won't know exactly which designs you'll receive until you open it! From cute everyday pieces to trendy statement styles, each jar brings a little sparkle to your jewellery collection.
What's Inside?
- ✨ 3–4 Jewellery Items in every jar
- 💛 Mix of Anti-Tarnish & Korean-Style Jewellery
- 🎀 Different trendy designs in every jar
- 💎 Perfect for everyday styling
- 🎁 A fun and affordable gifting option
- 💰 Only ₹299
Why You'll Love It
The Classic Mystery Jar is perfect for anyone who loves trying new jewellery without spending a lot. Whether you're treating yourself or surprising someone special, every jar is a tiny unboxing experience filled with sparkle and excitement.
Please Note: Cash on delivery is not available for this Product
And Jewellery designs are assorted and selected randomly. The exact pieces may vary from jar to jar.
✨ Unbox the surprise. Discover your sparkle
